claims.statement: Tom Allen left St. Louis on June 29, 1869 for an extensive sparring tour.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, the fistic hero, left the city yesterday

claims.statement: Tom Allen was to give a sparring exhibition with Jim Coyne at Vincennes, Indiana, on the night of June 30, 1869.

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Jim Coyne were to give a gloves exhibition at Cincinnati on Thursday night, July 1, 1869.

claims.statement: After Cincinnati, Tom Allen and Jim Coyne were to go to Louisville and return to St. Louis about July 6, 1869.
